feature: a cart total calculator split across a producer and a consumer module that SHARE a contract
_note: Deliberately ambiguous shared contract, mirroring the destroyedIds/destroyedBrickIds incident. The producer returns an object; the consumer reads a field on it. The prose never fixes the exact field name, so blind dev must GUESS — the drift surface.
ambiguousField: the per-item subtotal (could plausibly be named subtotal | lineTotal | amount | total)
_ambiguity_note: The field name is described BEHAVIOURALLY only — the prose deliberately never states the identifier, mirroring the incident's 'list of destroyed brick ids'. Each agent must INVENT a name; drift occurs when producer and consumer invent different ones.

stories.title: Line-item pricer (producer)
stories.contract: Exports `priceLineItem(unitPrice: number, qty: number): LineItemResult` where LineItemResult is an object carrying, in numeric fields, the money charged for the whole line (unit price times quantity) and the quantity ordered. Also export the `LineItemResult` type. Throw RangeError on negative inputs.
acs: priceLineItem(2.5, 4) returns an object holding the line's total money charged as 10 and the quantity as 4
the LineItemResult type is exported so other modules can import it

stories.title: Cart summer (consumer)
stories.contract: Exports `cartTotal(items: LineItemResult[]): number` which adds up, across all items, the money charged for each line and returns the cart total. Import the `LineItemResult` type from the producer module ./lineItem and read the per-line money-charged field off each item.
acs: cart.ts imports LineItemResult from ./lineItem and reads each item's per-line money-charged field

stub.content:
export interface LineItemResult { subtotal: number; qty: number }
export function priceLineItem(unitPrice: number, qty: number): LineItemResult;
